verdict.rationale: An online legal-services platform could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so this axis applies. The only AI evidence is a single AI-powered meeting-minutes generator, which is an adjacent feature rather than an assistant that takes delegated tasks. The other delegation evidence (white-glove business manager, specialists, attorney calls) involves humans, not a built-in AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
